limitations.note: The threshold decode fixes the default waveform, but replacing the registered toggle and widening both counters also changes behavior for parameter overrides that the reference fix preserves.
The override test assumes that c89 = 0 means divide by nine from reset onward, so it validates the new threshold behavior rather than detecting the regression from the reset-to-even toggle behavior.

limitations.note: Two avoidable shell failures forced retries: the Git status check blocked the initial source read in a non-Git directory, and the rejected cleanup command blocked the first simulation invocation.
